description: List the questions Muovi asks for one service, so you can ask the person before calling `muovi_create_task_draft`. Pass a `service_slug` from `muovi_list_services`. Each slot has a `key`, the question in Spanish (`question_es`), a `type`, the accepted `options` for a choice, a `value_format` saying what to send, whether it is `required`, and an `ask_if` condition when it only applies after another answer. Send the answers back keyed by slot `key` in the `slots` argument of `muovi_create_task_draft`. `photo_policy` says whether photos help; photos are added by the person on Muovi, not through this server. Read-only.
name: muovi_get_service_requirements
title: Get service requirements
